drivingQuestion: What do the two obstructions of Genesis 20:18 refer to?

segments.he: ״כִּי עָצֹר עָצַר ה׳״ – אָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר: שְׁתֵּי עֲצִירוֹת הַלָּלוּ לָמָּה? אַחַת בְּאִישׁ – שִׁכְבַת זֶרַע, שְׁתַּיִם בְּאִשָּׁה – שִׁכְבַת זֶרַע וְלֵידָה.
segments.en: Having mentioned the verses concerning the incident of Abraham and Abimelech, the Gemara explains other related verses. «“For the Lord had obstructed [atzor atzar]» all the wombs of the house of Abimelech” (Genesis 20:18). «Rabbi Elazar says: Why» are «these two obstructions [atzor atzar]» both stated? «One» is stated «with regard to a man,» that «semen» will not be discharged, and «two» are stated «with regard to a woman,» that «semen» will not be discharged from her, «and» that she will not give «birth.»

segments.he: בְּמַתְנִיתָא תְּנָא: שְׁתַּיִם בְּאִישׁ – שִׁכְבַת זֶרַע וּקְטַנִּים, שְׁלֹשָׁה בָּאִשָּׁה – שִׁכְבַת זֶרַע וּקְטַנִּים וְלֵידָה.
segments.en: It «was taught in a baraita: Two» are stated «with regard to a man: Semen and urine,» i.e., that the men were unable to both urinate and discharge semen; «three» are stated «with regard to a woman: Semen, and urine, and birth.»

segments.he: רָבִינָא אָמַר: שָׁלֹשׁ בְּאִישׁ – שִׁכְבַת זֶרַע וּקְטַנִּים וּפִי טַבַּעַת, אַרְבָּעָה בְּאִשָּׁה – שִׁכְבַת זֶרַע וְלֵידָה וּקְטַנִּים וּפִי טַבַּעַת.
segments.en: «Ravina says: Three» are stated «with regard to a man: Semen, and urine, and» the «anal sphincter,» i.e., that they were unable to discharge stool as well. Consequently, they would be unable to relieve themselves at all. «Four» are stated «with regard to a woman: Semen, and birth, and urine, and» the «anal sphincter.»
